title: Inventory (inventory/<name>.json)
description: inventory/<name>.json: the modules of the client's software that the process would likely use. Optional: it fills the Modules likely to be used section of Original data received and of the systems inventory. Every module is our suggestion, read from the records. Field meanings are in formats/FORMATS.md section 3.2.

map.description: The name of a valid map in process-map/ of the same workspace: the steps and software the modules name are that map's.

moduleId.description: MOD- and two digits, unique in the file.

title.description: The module as the product names it, then what it does: Module A1 · request intake. Name prose (FORMATS.md section 2.5).

steps.description: The steps of the map the module would serve: steps, not decisions (inv-2).

cite.description: At least one inferred citation: a module is always our suggestion (cite-4). Grounded citations may be added; web sources never alone (cite-5).
